10. Why crypto calibration is noisy

1. Endogeneity
Flow responds to price. OLS y is not
causal; it absorbs momentum trader

reactions. Note weak R-squared and
day-to-day coefficient drift.

3. Fragmentation / Perp Leadership

BTCUSDT spot is just one venue.
Perpetual futures often lead price
discovery, injecting structural noise
into spot regressions.

2. Concave Impact
Real impact is empirically square-root,
not linear.

Fix: Calibrate parameters specifically at
the participation rates you intend to
trade.

4. Regime Dependence

Impact roughly doubles when vol doubles.
Asia session 7 does not match US open.

Fix: Fit weekly, per session.

The Saving Grace: The cost function is flat near the optimum.

Kk x ./(1/n), So a 2x error in 7 moves xk by only V2. Precision is required for
pre-trade estimates; robustness suffices for the actual schedule.
